name: Lyo.Email.Smtp
description: MailKit SMTP implementation of `Lyo.Email`. `SmtpEmailService` maps one `EmailRequest` to a MIME message, including display names, content types, reply-to, headers, and priority. One connection per single send. A bulk send reuses one connection. `AddSmtpEmailServiceFromConfiguration` binds the `SmtpEmailOptions` section.
features: **MIME.** Recipient names, attachment content types, reply-to, custom headers, and priority are written onto the message.
**Bulk.** One SMTP connection for the batch. `BulkEmailConcurrencyLimit` does not change that path.
**Auth.** Authentication runs only when both username and password are set.
**Probe.** `TestConnectionAsync` connects and disconnects. Cancellation throws. Any other failure returns false.
**Parser.** `EmailMimeParser` reads a `.eml` payload. It does not talk to a mailbox.
**Secrets.** `ToString()` includes the username and omits the password.

examples.title: Register via a callback

sections.title: Connection security
sections.body: `UseSsl` false is MailKit `StartTlsWhenAvailable`. True is `SslOnConnect`. The default is false. A disconnect error after a successful send is logged and does not fail the result.

sections.title: Bulk failures
sections.body: A connect or auth failure marks every built message `EMAIL_SEND_FAILED`. A per-message send error is recorded and the loop continues. Cancel during connect marks every built message `EMAIL_OPERATION_CANCELLED`. Cancel during a send records that code and stops.
